title: Export bookmarks
description: Download your WakeMark bookmarks as Markdown, JSON, or CSV for Obsidian, scripts, and backups.

hero.title: Export bookmarks
hero.subtitle: Take your AI-tagged bookmarks with you anytime as offline files.

why.title: Why export?
why.p1: WakeMark keeps your bookmarks searchable and organized, but you should always be able to leave with your data.
why.p2: Exports include tweet text, AI summaries, tags, links, and media references — without embedding vectors.

formats.title: Available formats
formats.markdownBody: One .md file per bookmark with YAML frontmatter, tweet quote, and AI summary. The zip also includes export.json and export.csv.
formats.jsonBody: A single structured file for scripts, automation, or custom tooling.
formats.csvBody: Spreadsheet-friendly rows with ids, urls, tags, summaries, and links.

how.title: How to export
how.step1: Open your bookmarks board in the dashboard.
how.step2: Use Export in the toolbar to download all visible bookmarks, or enter selection mode to export only selected items.
how.step3: Choose Markdown zip, JSON, or CSV. Trash bookmarks are never included.
